findings.title: Feature-flagged table visualization discards the query results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch passes `columns: []` and an empty `tableData` instead of the current `result`'s columns, metadata, and data. Dashboards using the new visualization will therefore show a blank table despite successful queries. Pass the actual result data and derived columns to the component.

findings.title: Zero-valued age bypasses the mutually exclusive timestamp check
findings.body: This check uses truthiness rather than field presence. A report containing both `age: 0` and `timestamp: 0` passes both validators, even though the endpoint requires exactly one field. Check whether the other key is present in the input so this invalid combination is rejected.
